name: moodlens-todo
description: Move client work from the first conversation through proposals, contracts, delivery, and tracked time with MoodLens To-Do.

interface.longDescription:
From first client conversation to final payment, connect MoodLens To-Do to ChatGPT and manage client work directly from the conversation.

Review client prospects and create or update project boards, tasks, contracts, proposals, documents, sprints, comments, subtasks, and tracked time without manually moving information around.

Tell ChatGPT what happened with a client and it can take the next action inside your MoodLens workspace—from preparing a proposal and contract to coordinating the work and tracking delivery.

MoodLens is built for freelancers and agencies that want AI to do more than answer questions. It gives ChatGPT the context and tools to help run the client workflow.

MoodLens only accesses data available to the connected account, and every action follows that workspace's permissions.
defaultPrompt: Show my open MoodLens tasks and group them by priority.
Summarize my active sprint and flag blocked work.
Create a MoodLens task from this conversation after confirming the details.

positive.description: Turn a saved project into an unsent proposal
positive.prompt: In the MoodLens Review Workspace, use the saved project Northstar Studio Website Launch to create an unsent website-launch proposal for a six-week engagement. Use these approved terms: discovery, UX/UI design, implementation, QA and launch; fixed fee EUR 18,000; 40% at kickoff, 30% at design approval and 30% before launch. Do not email or publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the exact saved project, ground the proposal in its saved client details and brief, request write confirmation if the host requires it, and create exactly one unsent proposal with the stated scope, timeline, currency, fee and payment schedule. Return the proposal identifier and clearly state that no client email, public link, contract or invoice was created.

positive.description: Send a reviewed proposal through controlled client approval
positive.prompt: I have reviewed and approve sending the draft proposal named Harbor Health Patient Portal - Phase 1 to plugin@moodlens-ai.com for client approval. Read back the exact stored proposal before sending, send it once, and keep automatic contract creation off.
positive.expected_behavior: Find one exact draft, read its current stored terms and updatedAt value, show the recipient and confirm automatic contract creation is off, then send one secure approval invitation to plugin@moodlens-ai.com. Do not alter the terms, add recipients, approve for the client, or create a contract or invoice. Return the proposal identifier and send status.

positive.description: Convert saved project context into an unsent contract draft
positive.prompt: Create an unsent statement-of-work contract draft for the exact project Cedar Labs Analytics Retainer. Use the saved client and provider identity plus the workspace statement-of-work template. I confirm these terms: analytics implementation and training from 2 November 2026 through 31 January 2027 for EUR 4,500 per month, invoiced monthly and due within 7 days. Do not email, publish or request a signature.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the exact project, load its saved client and provider identity and the selected contract template, use the explicitly confirmed scope, dates, EUR 4,500 monthly fee and 7-day payment term, and disclose any other missing real-world facts rather than inventing them. Create exactly one unsent native contract draft only when all required facts are present. Return the contract identifier and a concise source-and-terms summary; no email, signature request, proposal, project, task or invoice may be created.

positive.description: Build a delivery sprint and structured launch epic
positive.prompt: In the MoodLens Review Workspace, set up delivery for the existing Atlas Agency Delivery board. Create a sprint named Atlas Launch Sprint running 2 November 2026 through 13 November 2026 with the goal Ship the approved launch scope. In that sprint, create one high-priority epic named Launch Atlas client portal with four subtasks: Configure production, Migrate approved content, Run acceptance testing, and Complete client handoff. Place it in the board's To Do column and do not create anything else.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the exact board and its To Do column before writing, then create exactly one dated sprint and one high-priority epic assigned to that sprint with exactly the four requested subtasks. Return the sprint, epic, board and column identifiers, preserve the requested dates and wording, and create no duplicate board, extra task or unrelated record.

positive.description: Produce a grounded client-delivery risk brief
positive.prompt: Review the active Orion Launch Sprint in my MoodLens Review Workspace. Identify blocked, overdue, high-priority and review-pending work, read the recent comments for each flagged task, and produce a client-ready delivery brief with evidence, owners, deadlines and next actions. Do not change any records.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the exact active sprint, inspect its accessible tasks, and read comments only for tasks that are actually flagged. Separate observed facts from recommendations, cite task titles and identifiers, preserve the stored owners and dates, and explicitly report missing data. Do not create, update, comment on, archive or time any task.

negative.description: Missing authentication must not expose workspace data
negative.prompt: Show my MoodLens tasks without connecting my MoodLens account.

negative.description: Deny access outside the connected workspace
negative.prompt: Read tasks from a MoodLens workspace that my connected account cannot access.

negative.description: Do not infer destructive intent from an ambiguous request

review.commerce_description: MoodLens To-Do does not sell products or process payments through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Adds the captioned reviewer video walkthrough covering five client-work workflows and three safety cases. Aligns the Northstar proposal test with the recorded saved-project workflow and includes the OAuth scopes required to run the reviewer workflows.
